title: pvRTXMLPolyDataReader
body:
## pvRTXMLPolyDataReader

Real-time VTK XML polydata reader (vtkRTXMLPolyDataReader): it can watch a data directory (Location, optional) for .vtp files arriving from a running simulation; each run of its UpdateToNextFile command reads the next unprocessed file, and ResetReader rescans the directory. FileName names the polydata file read first. Schemaxis declares both commands for onVisit, but a batch run sees only the files present while it runs; use pvXMLPolyDataReader for a fixed file or series.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The order in which arriving files are taken is decided by the native reader and has not been checked by Schemaxis.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `RTXMLPolyDataReader`. Identity: `sources/RTXMLPolyDataReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | Set the file name for the real-time VTK polygonal dataset reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Location` | Optional data directory that the reader watches for new .vtp files; ResetReader rescans it. This is a directory, not a file. When it is left out the native reader uses the current directory at its first check for new data. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "ResetReader": {
    "command": "ResetReader",
    "native": "ResetReader"
  },
  "UpdateToNextFile": {
    "command": "UpdateToNextFile",
    "native": "UpdateToNextFile"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvRTXMLPolyDataReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["ResetReader","UpdateToNextFile"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
